model_annotation: The chart illustrates negative log probability values for “per-specialty terms” when evaluated with a Mistralv0.2-Base model and variants fine-tuned on different medical specialties, shown as grouped vertical bars for each specialty term set. The horizontal axis contains the category groups labeled (left to right) Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics under the axis label “Per-specialty terms,” and each group contains multiple adjacent bars corresponding to the base model and the different fine-tuning specialties indicated by the legend. The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and uses a linear numeric scale with labeled ticks at approximately −22, −23, −24, −25, −26, and −27 (regular 1-unit intervals), spanning roughly from −22 at the top to −27 at the bottom; bars extend downward to their negative values. Within each specialty group, the first bar is light blue (Mistralv0.2-Base) and the remaining bars are shades from light peach through darker orange/brown for the fine-tuned-on conditions (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics). Approximate bar endpoints by group are: for Cardio terms, the light-blue base bar is near −26.8, while the fine-tuned bars cluster around about −25.7 to −26.1 (darkest brown near −26.1); for Gastro terms, the base bar is around −24.8 and the fine-tuned bars run roughly from about −23.8 to −24.2; for Infect terms, the base bar is around −23.7 and the fine-tuned bars lie near about −23.0 to −23.3; for Neuro terms, the base bar is around −25.3 and fine-tuned bars are approximately −24.2 to −24.6; for Obstetrics terms, the base bar is around −24.7 and fine-tuned bars are around −23.7 to −24.0; and for Pediatrics terms, the base bar is around −24.7 and fine-tuned bars are around −23.6 to −24.0. The bars are arranged as side-by-side groups (not stacked), follow the fixed specialty order shown on the x-axis rather than an apparent sort by value, and there are no visible outlines, callouts, or numeric annotations emphasizing specific bars beyond the color legend.
